name: 210-via-beside-a-segment-just-clear
why: The same run and via, the via moved 0.66mm off the centreline. Copper reaches 0.25mm (half the trace width) plus 0.40mm (the annulus radius) = 0.65mm, so 0.01mm of laminate is left between them — ten times the 0.001mm coincidence tolerance. The via is 5mm from either end, so no endpoint rule is in play either way: only the two radii decide it.
